purpose: Teach: はずす/淋しい/逢い/ぐったり/たいがい/楽々/あわせる/あたえ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんはサングラスをはずすと優しい目をしてるのよ
lines.en: Sho — when I take off my sunglasses, my eyes are kind, aren't they?
lines.style: Gentle, affectionate lilt. Speaking as though sharing a small, tender secret. Warm breath behind the words. Slight upward inflection at the end — inviting his agreement without demanding it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、メイ姉さんがいなくて淋しい時もあったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — there were times when I felt lonely without you.
lines.style: Soft and honest, the words coming carefully. Not performed — genuinely vulnerable. A small pause before the confession. Voice settles at the end like he's admitting something he's been holding.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんとまた逢いに行きましょうね
lines.en: Sho — let's go see Grandpa again soon, okay?
lines.style: Warm invitation, almost conspiratorial. Speaking gently but with quiet certainty — offering something she knows he needs. Slight downward cadence, settled and sure.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、夏祭りでぐったり疲れちゃった
lines.en: Mei-sis — I got so tired at the summer festival.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact weariness beneath a thin layer of dry humor. Not complaining, just stating the fact. Small, almost rueful laugh buried in the delivery. Trailing fade at the end.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、たいがいの絵は描けるようになったわね
lines.en: Sho — you've gotten so good at drawing almost anything now, haven't you?
lines.style: Quiet admiration, genuinely noticing his growth. Spoken with the warmth of someone watching a child become more capable. Gentle emphasis on his progress without overdoing it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ピアノが楽々弾けるようになったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I can play piano so smoothly now!
lines.style: Bright, genuine pride in his voice. The lift of a child discovering what his own hands can do. Slight bounce in the pacing. Not seeking approval — simply delighted with himself.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんの予定にあわせるからね
lines.en: Sho — I'll adjust my schedule to match yours.
lines.style: Gentle reassurance, spoken with quiet certainty. No hesitation or self-sacrifice in the tone — just matter-of-fact care. Warm and steady, like setting something in its proper place.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんがおこづかいあたえてくれたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — Grandpa gave me my allowance!
lines.style: Eager and bright, the excitement of a child with a small treasure. Quick uptempo delivery. The pride of having been trusted with something of his own. Final word peaks with energy.
